name: The Ackerman Concession Model
scenario: Commercial buyer purchasing specialized manufacturing tooling with a list price of $500,000, targeting an acquisition price of $400,000.
script: Round 2 (85%): "We reviewed our operational funds; we can push to $340,000."
Round 3 (95%): "We secured an executive sign-off to reach $380,000."
Round 4 (100%): "We have exhausted our reserve. The absolute maximum we can execute is $401,350, and we will sign the agreement today."
defense: Name the curve: this is the Ackerman sequence; the final figure is still below our cost of delivery; restructure scope.
originFull: Algorithmic Concession Scheduling combines anchoring, diminishing concession rates, and psychological precision into a structured bidding sequence (65% → 85% → 95% → 100% of target).
defenseFull: Neutralize the formulaic sequence: "This sequence follows a classic Ackerman concession curve. While we recognize the structural discipline, your final figure remains below our cost of delivery. We need to restructure the project scope."
